expect.body: Huanglong and Jiuzhaigou are high altitude areas and may cause altitude sickness. Walk slowly and stay hydrated.
expect.title: High Altitude Areas

expect.body: Expect plenty of walking, especially at Huanglong and Jiuzhaigou. Comfortable shoes recommended.
expect.title: Required Walking

expect.body: Guests will stay in hotels in Chengdu, Jiuzhaigou and Dujiangyan. Keep your bags packed and organised.
expect.title: Multiple Hotels

expect.body: Intercity transfers via bullet train and private transport.
expect.title: Intercity Transfer

expect.body: Download WeChat and set up E-wallet (Alipay) as some places may prefer cashless payments.
expect.title: Communication & Payment

expect.body: The drop-off point may not be directly at the entrance & may require walking.

activities: (Suggested Flight: AirAsia X D7 326 18:05 - 22:40)
Arrive in Chengdu Tianfu Intl' Airport (TFU)
Airport Pickup
Transfer to hotel and check in
Rest for the day
itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur - Chengdu

activities: After breakfast, check out from hotel
Transfer to Huanglong by bullet train
Lunch and prayer at Local Mosque
Huanglong Scenic Area (Include cable car & battery car) (Stunning terraced pools formed by calcite deposits)
Transfer to Jiuzhaigou
Dinner and check in hotel in Jiuzhaigou
itinerary.title: Chengdu - Huanglong - Jiuzhaigou [Bullet Train]

activities: Full day at Jiuzhaigou National Park (Include shuttle bus) (A nature fairyland with emerald crystal lakes, colourful waterfalls and lush forests)
Rize Valley: Arrow Bamboo Lake, Five Flower Lake & Pearl Shoal Waterfall
Dinner and back to hotel
itinerary.title: Full Day Jiuzhaigou

activities: After breakfast, check out from hotel
Source of Minjiang River (Gonggangling)
Songpan Ancient Town (A historic military garrison and trade hub)
Songpan Mosque
Bullet train back to Chengdu
Night tour at SKP Bamboo Tower (Iconic landmark of 6 giant bamboo-shaped towers)
Dinner and check in hotel in Chengdu
itinerary.title: Jiuzhaigou - Songpan - Chengdu [Bullet Train]

activities: After breakfast, check out from hotel
Transfer to Dujiangyan
Dujiangyan Panda Base (Include electric cart) (See Giant Panda and Red Panda)
Yangtianwo Selfie Square
Local Mosque
Zhongshuge Bookstore (Two-storey bookstore with unique architecture)
Night tour at Dujiangyan "Blue Tears" (Neon-blue illumination of the Minjiang River)
Dinner and check in hotel in Dujiangyan
itinerary.title: Chengdu - Dujiangyan

activities: After breakfast, check out from hotel
Transfer back to Chengdu

sub: Mar - Apr (Spring): Manhua Manor + Glass Bridge (Breathtaking flower park)
May - Dec (Summer / Autumn): Face-changing show + Gaiwan tea @ Kuanzhai Alley (Historic cultural district)

activities: Imperial City Mosque (Huangcheng Mosque, the largest mosque in Sichuan)
Chunxi Road, IFS & Taikoo Li (Shopping district with the iconic climbing panda)
After dinner, transfer to airport
